text:
Alyssa: Kickoff for HelixCare pilot. Requirements: streaming SDK demo (Python), function/tool-calls that emit structured JSON for downstream ETL, SAML SSO, KMS for PHI, and a reserved capacity estimate. Who can own SDK + perf?
Ben S: I can run the SDK samples and perf harness. Start with Python, then Node.
Priya S: I'll handle security questionnaire: encryption, key separation, SOC2/DPA. Need an annotated KMS diagram.
Kevin L: For SSO we have an SP template. @Alyssa please upload their IdP metadata. Capacity note: they expect ~40 rps steady, bursts to 150. Target p50 <200ms.
Alyssa: IdP metadata + preliminary security answers uploaded: https://drive.redwood.com/helix/poc (folder: security).
DevBot: Ticket created: POC-4012 assigned to Alyssa, Ben S. Due: 2026-03-28.
Ben S: Minimal Python streaming example for demo harness:
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="REDACTED")
with client.streaming.generate(model="rw-small-quant", stream=True) as s:
    s.call_tool("json_mapper", {"doc": payload})
    for e in s:
        if e.type == "tool_output":
            print(e.text)  # expected JSON string
```
Alyssa: Good. Add a simple schema validator in the harness to fail if JSON contract mismatches. Also provide curl/WebSocket fallback for their infra team.
Kevin L: I'll produce a provisional Dedicated commit estimate (~1.6k GPU-hours/mo) and a fallback policy (Dedicated -> autoscale canary -> hosted small model). Will refine after Ben's perf run.
Priya S: I'll attach SOC2 summary and draft section on KMS key separation for PHI to the drive. Looping Legal for DPA.
Ben S: Running perf now on rw-small-quant with 2x batcher. Will upload p50/p95 numbers in ~20m to drive/tools/perf/helix.
Alyssa: Acceptance criteria for pilot: 1) streaming demo with tool-call returns validated JSON; 2) p50 <200ms at 40 rps sustained; 3) SAML SSO tested E2E; 4) DPA signed + SOC2 available. Proposed demo slot Fri 9am PT.
DevBot: Reminder: add billing contact to POC-4012 to generate formal estimate.
Ben S: Uploaded perf artifacts and sample payloads to drive.
Kevin L: Posted refined commit estimate and fallback runbook.
Priya S: Security QA draft complete; legal pinged for DPA.
Alyssa: Thanks team ":thumbsup:" Will confirm demo once Legal + perf done.
